npcActionAbilities.name: Power Slam
npcActionAbilities.description: Make an attack against an opponent. If you hit, perform a Brawn Contest. If they fail, they are staggered, and all attacks against them are critical hits until the start of your next turn.

npcActionAbilities.name: Combo Action- Knee Jab
npcActionAbilities.description: After successfully landing an attack on a target within your reach, you can make an additional attack as an Unarmed Strike on the same target. On a successful attack, in addition to dealing damage, perform a Grit Contest and if the target fails they gain the Winded condition until the end of your next turn.

npcActionAbilities.name: Cross Attack
npcActionAbilities.description: After you make an attack action on your turn and miss, you can perform a Cross Attack, making a second attack that follows along your initial slash but in the opposite direction. On a hit, you inflict the bleed condition until the start of your next turn.

npcActionAbilities.name: Downward Strike
npcActionAbilities.description: While using a weapon in both hands, you can make a large strike on a target’s head, giving you an additional +1 to damage for each rank in this class.

npcActionAbilities.name: FINISHER- Executioner’s Cleave
npcActionAbilities.description: You swing with one massive slash. Make an attack roll with this weapon and on a hit, your target’s toughness is halved and the armor gains the Damaged property. You become staggered after using this ability.

npcActionAbilities.name: COMBO- Dismemberment
npcActionAbilities.description: After you perform an attack that inflicted Bleed, you can perform another powerful chop, opening the wound further. On a successful hit, the target must make a DC 15 Grit roll or gain 2 additional stacks of the Bleed condition for 1 minute on a fail and 1 additional stack of the Bleed condition for 1 minute on a success.

npcActionAbilities.name: Horrifying Visage
npcActionAbilities.description: Choose a creature who can hear and see you within 3 meters. Perform a Swagger contest. On a success, the target gains the Alarmed condition until the end of your next turn.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Marksman (5)
npcPassiveAbilities.description: Gain a +5 to all Hand-Firearm attacks

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Marked by Flames
npcPassiveAbilities.description: You cannot take Fire damage. You cannot gain the Burned condition.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Burning
npcPassiveAbilities.description: Whenever someone is fails a Finesse roll from one of this enemies grenade's Explosion, they gain 1 stack of the Burn condition.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Part of the Crew
npcPassiveAbilities.description: While in Ship Combat, never roll this NPC for Ship Action Point rolls. Instead, this NPC always gives 3 SAP.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Fast Learner
npcPassiveAbilities.description: Whenever you are learning or improving a skill, it takes half the time.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Cannon Fodder
npcPassiveAbilities.description: You cannot participate in ship combat. You do not generate Ship Action Points and cannot take Ship Action. You can only panic.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Brandishing Light
npcPassiveAbilities.description: Whenever this NPC damages a Monster or Undead creature, deal an additional 1d6 Holy damage.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Bare Boned
npcPassiveAbilities.description: You take double damage from bludgeoning weapons.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: No Body
npcPassiveAbilities.description: You are immune to Poison and Bleeding damage and automatically pass all Grit rolls.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: No Tales
npcPassiveAbilities.description: You can never have information coerced from it through magical or nonmagical means.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Unholy Renaimation
npcPassiveAbilities.description: Whenever you run out of Endurance, you become unconscious and prone. At the end of your next turn you become conscious again and can use Health as if it was Endurance.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Destructive Nature
npcPassiveAbilities.description: Whenever you score a critical hit, the target gains the Bleeding condition until healed.

npcPassiveAbilities.name: Ghostly
npcPassiveAbilities.description: This creature can walk through walls as if they are not there
